name: Daulatabad Fort
scope: Whole surviving Daulatabad architectural ensemble: all twelve selected native castle/city-defense wall traces and upper-citadel perimeter, their intrinsic bastions/crenellations and mapped gates; complete three-balcony red Chand Minar; summit Baradari white open gallery/dark flanking blocks; Chini Mahal palace-prison gateway; Bharat Mata/Jami Masjid courtyard colonnade and intrinsic Hathi Houz tank; artificial moat retaining/cut-rock edges and its own short crossing. Natural monolith is supplied by an independent frozen terrain field, not a generic cone or invented site slab. Exclude modern town buildings, unrelated temples, standalone cannons/exhibits, vegetation/paths/public landscape, signs/people/vehicles and reconstructed demolished historic wings.
era: Surviving historic ensemble, architectural forms based on exact published2006 PD originals and current native traces. Exact current restoration/cosmetics, hidden sections and individual bastion/merlon/column census unverified.

originalReview.notes: Exact whole published original individually inspected for this model and matched to native original SHA1/dimensions. Natural landscape, people, signs and standalone cannon artifacts are excluded. Fine sections/current cosmetic phase and hidden census remain bounded.

The said huge duct is called as "KHANDAK" which is generally used for protecting the fort from enemy attacks.
